derivation: Entry disk inventory had about 15 GiB available. An 8 GiB per-batch cap and 2 GiB untouched reserve fit that host; a 1 GiB per-run bound limits one defective recorder. These are explicit storage allocations, not autonomy or failure-invariant thresholds. Every failure, interrupted and unqualified run remains. Stop rather than deleting failures when capacity runs out.
